# pktgen

Traffic generator using DPDK pktgen (pktgen-dpdk).

Launches pktgen-dpdk with a Lua script to generate traffic at a given packet
size for `GEN_TIME` seconds. Collects throughput (`RESULT-THROUGHPUT`) and TX rate
(`RESULT-TX`) in Mbps.

Usage:
```bash
%import@client pktgen GEN_LENGTH=64 GEN_TIME=10
```

Source: [`modules/pktgen.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/pktgen.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GEN_CPU` | `8` | Number of CPU cores to use |
| `SND_NIC` | `0` | NIC index for sending |
| `GEN_TIME` | `5` | Duration of the test in seconds |
| `GEN_LENGTH` | `512` | Packet size in bytes |
